items.text: February is #NationalCancerPreventionMonth. As someone who experienced the overwhelming emotions after receiving a positive diagnosis, this is an important issue for me. Whatever your plan is - I encourage you not to wait and take that step to lower your risk of cancer today. https://t.co/PnwXAk8YLn

Happy National Day of Prayer. We are so fortunate to live in a country that guarantees the freedom of each citizen to exercise their religion. I look forward to joining our nation in prayer today. https://t.co/x7K2jGChke

Recent changes to the TRICARE Pharmacy Program will impact 400k beneficiaries and cut out 15k pharmacies mostly in small communities. The Idaho Delegation pressed the Defense Health Agency to ensure adequate patient access for servicemembers and veterans.  https://t.co/kt6KllH545

Idaho servicemembers and veterans should be free to go to trusted local pharmacists to pick up their prescription medication. Read the op-ed from the Idaho Congressional delegation on recent TRICARE changes that disproportionally harm small communities. https://t.co/VmoxVCKgnW

We must maximize the tools at our disposal — including fire retardant — in order to better fight the fires that threaten our local communities, economies, environment, & health.
Read more: https://t.co/v7eAtSzEYK

My prayers go to Majority Leader Steve Scalise upon his recent diagnosis of multiple myeloma. I am thankful to hear of his expected treatment for this treatable form of cancer and wish him a speedy recovery.

I voted to pass the Lower Cost, More Transparency Act today because it will reduce the deficit by more than $700 million and support patients, healthcare workers, and community health centers while addressing the cost of prescription drugs and maintaining pro-life protections. https://t.co/q6g7Yh05tS

Last week, I sat down with Michele Anderson, a Nurse Practitioner and Clinical Associate Professor at ISU, from Meridian, to talk about ways to increase and promote access to essential medical centers and devices. https://t.co/i8XNrn6DHg

The Biden administration is attempting to preempt Idaho's pro-life laws with the Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act, specifically written to protect unborn children and women in active labor.

Biden is attempting to preempt Idaho's pro-life laws with the Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act, specifically written to protect unborn children and women in active labor.

I submitted an amicus brief to SCOTUS on Tuesday to protect the lives of women and children.

Thank you to these members of the National Association of Benefits Insurance Professionals for taking the time to meet with my staff and share your first-hand expertise with health insurance issues impacting Idahoans. https://t.co/8SukKYbuCa

Proud to advance the FY25 Military Construction and VA Appropriations Bill. This legislation:

✅ Fully funds veteran health care and benefits programs
✅ Bolsters U.S. national security 
✅ Prohibits tax dollars from being used to fund abortions or far-left programs such as Critical Race Theory

Precisely.

President Biden’s utterly disastrous border policies are draining U.S. medical and retirement programs—at the expense of American taxpayers!

This will inevitably create a “crisis” to justify government intervention and further push our country towards socialism.

Americans who exercise their First Amendment right in the defense of 𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗲 should never have to worry about their federal government targeting them because of their beliefs.

Very proud to co-sponsor @RepChipRoy’s bill to repeal the weaponized and unconstitutional FACE Act.

A baby who is born during a botched abortion should receive the same life-saving medical care as any other newborn.

Such a sentence shouldn’t even have to be said or be an issue we need to vote on. 

Proud to vote YES on H.R. 21, the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act.

Congratulations to fellow Idahoan, Tom Schultz, on being named Chief of the @USDA’s Forest Service! 

I am confident Idaho and the West will benefit from his leadership in this critical role to prevent wildfires and restore health to our nation’s beautiful forests.

Had a terrific meeting with fellow Idahoan and U.S. Forest Service Chief Tom Schultz at a Western Caucus briefing.

We discussed the start of the wildfire season and how the Forest Service, under his leadership, is working to restore health to our nation’s beautiful forests and land.

Attention Boise veterans - the DAV is now offering a new parking lot shuttle service for those visiting the Boise VA Medical Center. We’re grateful to DAV for supporting our veterans. See details below! https://t.co/ugItu7lsAA

I have signed on as an original co-sponsor to the FLASH Act. 

The safety of American communities and the environmental health of federal lands along the U.S. Southwest border were devastated under the Biden-Harris administration’s historic border crisis. 

This legislation will further efforts to increase security at our southern border, protect against taxpayer dollars from being used to house illegal immigrants on federal lands, address the toxic trash piles left along the Southwest border, and ensure immigration law enforcement has the land access necessary to do their job.

My team and I had a terrific meeting with the staff at Stanton Healthcare touring their Meridian Clinic. 

The tremendous work they are doing to ensure Idaho families and women have access to exceptional medical care, resources, and support is truly making a difference.

I applaud @POTUS and @SecretaryBurgum's action to rescind the Biden-era Bureau of Land Management’s Conservation and Landscape Health rule—an effort I have been spearheading in the House through the WEST Act.

This rule would have effectively locked up millions of acres across the U.S. that countless families and businesses have relied on for grazing, ranching, and recreation for generations.

The administration’s move to roll back this regulation protects the way of life for Americans across the West and preserves Congress’s intent of multiple-use on public lands.

The Rural Health Transformation Fund, created under H.R. 1, provides a historic $50 billion for America’s rural healthcare system. 

Idahoans, regardless of how rural their community is, should have access to quality care close to home—this provision helps deliver just that.

The Democrat counterproposal to fund the government is a partisan non-starter.

It includes taxpayer-funded healthcare for those in this country illegally, strips $50B from rural hospitals, and adds $1.5T in spending.

This is party politics at the expense of American citizens.

Mifepristone kills and endangers women’s health.

It is alarming that a new variation of this life-terminating drug was approved while a safety review of its dangerous health implications is under review.

All life is precious, and I will continue to do everything I can in Congress to protect both expecting mothers and the unborn.

CBO has confirmed H.R. 1, the Working Families Tax Cuts, will lower premiums for Americans.

This transformative package, which is now federal law, puts Americans first and is set to increase Idahoans’ take-home pay by $12,200. https://t.co/AjsekfuMUc
